Named dunning settings. A business keeps several and assigns one per customer (the customer's `dunning_policy`); a customer with none uses the business dunning settings. A customer excluded from dunning stays excluded whatever the policy.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/dunning_policies`](/help/developers/api-reference/dunning-policies/list-dunning-policies) | List dunning policies |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/dunning_policies`](/help/developers/api-reference/dunning-policies/create-a-dunning-policy) | Create a dunning policy |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/dunning_policies/{dpol}`](/help/developers/api-reference/dunning-policies/get-a-dunning-policy) | Get a dunning policy |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/dunning_policies/{dpol}`](/help/developers/api-reference/dunning-policies/change-a-dunning-policy) | Change a dunning policy |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/dunning_policies/{dpol}/archive`](/help/developers/api-reference/dunning-policies/archive-a-dunning-policy) | Archive a dunning policy |
